senses.gloss: m. pl. (v. גָּד h. good luck, Fortune.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 6:1">Tosef. Sabb. VI</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 7:1">VII</cite>), 1 <he>המגבח לג׳</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>גורגדין</he>; oth. ed. <he>המגבה לגרגרן</he>) he who shaves his head (makes a bald-pate) for good luck (a superstitious practice).
